note: Sac County Conservation Board's wooded 98-acre park on the North Raccoon River, 1.5 mi N of Auburn (RV Life lists it as 'Grant County Park'). The modern campground (Area 1) sits mid-park near the shower house and playground, mostly shaded; Areas 2 and 3 are primitive tent areas. Resident host; the park closes nightly at 10:30 pm. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 (2026 page), 19 sites, 50-amp, water + sewer, FCFS, showers, dump, opens May 1 (closes ~2nd week of October, in season.note). Not waterfront confirmed: pads 100-140 m from the river behind a road and woods.
flags: WATERFRONT stays not waterfront: the North Raccoon (~30 m) runs the park's east edge; the campground loop is 100-140 m west of it, with a gravel park road and continuous woods between. No view.
SITES: the facility page says '9 ... full hook-ups and 11 sites have water and electricity' (20) but also 'This 19 site campground'; the park page gives 9 + 10 = 19. Count 19 kept.
PIN OK (on the campground loop). Website and phone 712-662-4530 confirmed.
